verdict.rationale: Granola's own API docs name this exact use case: extracting action items and automatically creating tasks in Linear, Jira or Todoist. Its OpenAPI spec lists webhook-endpoints, and a first-party Zapier integration automates post-meeting steps. However, the tracker-filing logic must be built by the user's agent or integration on top of note access, and the API is gated to Business/Enterprise plans. Missing for 10: a native Linear/Jira/Asana integration that files action items itself, documented details of webhook events firing per meeting, a documented end-to-end tracker workflow or Asana coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can automatically file each meeting's action items into my project tracker (Linear, Jira, Asana) using the product's API, webhooks, or native automations

citations.quote: Extract action items from meeting notes and automatically create tasks in Linear, Jira, Todoist, or your project management tool of choice.
